implemented_capabilities: Discovered opportunity document downloads now return durable RFP document IDs, parser job IDs, storage paths, storage receipts, and provenance to callers.
Downloaded RFP binaries persist storage receipts that identify Linode E3 bucket/key/endpoint/etag plus sha256, byte length, and content type.
Discovery-linked RFP records persist ingest workflow metadata, source opportunity document IDs, source URLs, storage receipts, parser policy, confidence gate threshold, and parse queue provenance.
Discovery-to-RFP ingest now records workflow runtime transitions for queued parse, duplicate-link, unsupported-file, download-failed, and parse-queue-failed outcomes.
Failed or unsupported intake paths project remediation tasks through the workflow runtime rather than disappearing into document status only.
Parser completion now records parse confidence review metadata and opens a workflow task when parser confidence is below the review gate.
Human parser confidence review is exposed through a server action and requirements-page controls to accept parser output or request correction.
Requirement rows inserted by the parser now use canonical RFP requirement schema fields and include source-trace workflow metadata for later requirement acceptance.
Opportunity document panels now show an intake stepper for discover, select, store, and parse progress and update in place after ingest.

Parser confidence review workflow tasks are now created only after parse completion, human review actions close the original review task, and failed/incomplete parses cannot be accepted from the UI or server action.

The requirements review panel now fetches the opportunity's RFP documents without a server-side cap, prioritizes every actionable low-confidence parse review, and only truncates non-actionable filler documents.

F-005B.reason: Code and unit proof now cover discovery-linked server-side storage receipts, RFP record creation, parser job creation, provenance, and workflow runtime audit. Live Linode E3/browser fixture proof is still required before pass.

F-006B.reason: Code and unit proof now cover parser confidence gate metadata, low-confidence workflow task projection, and human accept/correction actions. Browser proof and versioned artifact review fixtures are still required before pass.

F-007.reason: Parser-created requirements now carry source-trace workflow metadata and existing requirement acceptance gates remain tested. End-to-end browser acceptance/reopen proof is still required before pass.

O-007.reason: This slice consumes the existing Linode E3 upload/download implementation and adds receipt propagation; prior live E3 readback remains the only live object-store proof.

O-015A.reason: New runtime transitions and audit events are emitted for intake and parser review paths, but audit explorer reconstruction was not rerun for this run.
